###### November 24, 2026


# A. O. Smith Named Lowe's 2026 Sustainability Partner of the Year


MILWAUKEE, Wis. (Nov. 24, 2026) – Global water technology company A. O. Smith Corporation (NYSE: AOS) (the “Company”) has been named Lowe's 2026 Sustainability Partner of the Year, recognizing what Lowe’s describes as the Company's leadership in energy efficiency, water stewardship and operational greenhouse gas emissions reduction.


Presented annually to a single supplier, the award honors a vendor that demonstrates outstanding leadership, measurable environmental impact and meaningful contributions to sustainability and corporate responsibility1. Lowe's evaluates suppliers based on factors, including greenhouse gas emissions reductions, resource conservation, waste diversion, industry collaboration and leadership in high-efficiency product offerings. The selection is made through Lowe's assessment process and review of vendors' product portfolios and environmental, social and governance (ESG) initiatives.


According to Lowe's, A. O. Smith was selected for its leadership in energy efficiency, water stewardship and operational emissions reduction. In the U.S., the Company offers a[portfolio](https://www.aosmithatlowes.com/) of ENERGY STAR® certified models that help homeowners reduce utility costs, energy use and associated emissions compared with standard-efficiency models.


A. O. Smith has made progress through initiatives focused on water conservation, greenhouse gas emissions reduction and landfill waste diversion2. As of 2025, the Company reported in its 2026 Sustainability Report a 32% reduction in Scope 1 and 2 greenhouse gas emissions intensity from a 2019 baseline, 99 million gallons of annual water savings from a 2023 baseline and the diversion of 809,000 pounds of landfill waste from a 2024 baseline through reduction, recycling and reuse efforts3. Facility improvements and resource conservation projects across its global operations contributed to these results.


**About A. O. Smith**


A. O. Smith Corporation, with headquarters in Milwaukee, Wisconsin, is a global leader applying innovative technology to products manufactured and marketed worldwide. Listed on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE: AOS), the Company is one of the world's leading manufacturers of residential and commercial water heating equipment and boilers, as well as a manufacturer of water treatment and water management products. For more information, visit[www.aosmith.com](https://aosmith.com/) .


**Footnote:**


1.


**Third-party awards and recognitions.** Third-party awards reflect the criteria and evaluation processes established by the awarding organization. They are presented to identify recognition received by A. O. Smith and do not represent A. O. Smith environmental certifications.


2.


**External verification.** SCS Global Services independently verified, at a limited-assurance level, the following 2025 Climate & Environment metrics: GHG emissions intensity; Scope 1 GHG emissions for 2019, 2024 and 2025; Scope 2 location-based GHG emissions for 2019, 2024 and 2025; water use at goal locations for 2025; and waste to landfill for 2025.


3.


**Environmental goals and performance metrics.** The greenhouse gas (GHG) emissions-intensity result is measured against a 2019 baseline. The water-savings result is measured against a 2023 baseline, and the waste-to-landfill result is measured against a 2024 baseline.


GHG emissions intensity covers manufacturing operations, excluding three small facilities and acquisitions since 2019, representing 97% of the operational boundary. Scope 1 and Scope 2 location-based emissions calculations use the latest electric-grid emissions factors available on Jan. 1 of each reporting year. GHG emissions-intensity is calculated by MT CO2e/$MM revenue.


Water-goal locations represent 99% of the operational boundary. Water savings include reduced water use and qualifying recycled or recirculated water.


Waste to landfill covers the seven largest North American manufacturing plants, representing 90% of total waste to landfill within the operational boundary. The 2024 waste baseline was restated in the Sustainability Report due to an additional waste stream identified.


Figures are rounded for presentation, while changes and goal progress are calculated using underlying data; totals may therefore differ slightly.
